name: drgreat-tcm
description: Dependencies for Cloudflare Pages Functions (Web Push).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run version:assets
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy . --project-name=cheungec --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy . --project-name=cheungec --branch=preview --commit-dirty=true
